name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Plex share codes now auto-connect a Jellyfin friend without both people being on the same Tailscale. Pasting a Companion connect code claims it server-to-server (or uses Plex Remote Access/Relay when Companion has no public Funnel URL), maps shared libraries automatically, and refuses LAN/100.x tailnet addresses that only work on a private network.
